paragraphs.text: Allenal is the half- elven queen of the Llanowar elfhame Ruadach on Dominara .

Thanks to their long lifespan, many elves still remember the first Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria. The half-elf Queen Allenal, of the Llanowar elfhame Ruadach, is one of these. She was born as the daughter of Queen Terena . Terena ruled for 600 years until she was killed in the Phyrexian invasion . The 400-year-old Allenal now holds the throne.
When her mother was killed by the interplanar invaders hundreds of years ago, the young Queen Allenal swore she would take revenge one day. Now that the Phyrexians have returned, she has her chance.
